notes_text: Open-world third-person action and satire, set after an alien invasion, where a protagonist develops superpowers and uses unusual weapons. Steam's exact product title is Saints Row IV: Re-Elected (not a separate edition in the frozen assignment), and lists 22 August 2013 release; it offers single-player and online co-op.

source_log.observation: Steam page confirms Re-Elected edition title, superpowers, aliens, original date and online cooperation.
